name: ContractWorks
description_en:
ContractWorks is a hosted contract repository with AI-assisted tagging, OCR search, reporting, reminders and electronic signature. The current site distinguishes the repository product from ContractWorks Premium, which adds drafting, redlining and approval workflows.

The buying question is whether the team needs control over already signed agreements or also the work before signature. Unlimited repository users do not mean every user can send documents for signature: sender licences have their own allowance.
description_zh:
ContractWorks 是托管合同库，提供 AI 辅助标签、OCR 搜索、报表、提醒和电子签署。当前官网区分合同库产品与 ContractWorks Premium；后者增加起草、修订和审批流程。

采购时要区分已签合同管理与签署前工作。合同库用户不限量，不代表每位用户都能发起签署；签署发送人的许可另有额度。

core_features.explanation_zh: 以标签、OCR 搜索及权限管理集中协议。

core_features.explanation_en: Use automated date alerts, custom reporting and scheduled reports.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用自动日期提醒、自定义及定时报表。

core_features.explanation_en: The Premium scope adds drafting, redlining and approval workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: Premium 范围增加起草、修订及审批流程。

sections.title_en: Organize existing agreements before adding CLM
sections.title_zh: 先整理已签协议，再决定是否扩展 CLM
sections.en: An initial project could import signed supplier agreements, inspect AI tags for the parties and renewal terms, then set owners and notice reminders. The repository includes custom fields, search and OCR. Agree on the metadata before a large import; a notice period and an expiry date represent different business events. Confirm proposed tags against the signed file, especially where an amendment changes the term.
sections.zh: 入门项目可先导入已签供应商协议，复核 AI 标注的签约方及续约条款，再设置负责人和通知提醒。合同库包含自定义字段、搜索和 OCR。大规模导入前应确定元数据；通知期与到期日属于不同业务事件。尤其有补充协议时，要用签署文件复核标签。

sections.title_en: Do not buy repository access expecting drafting workflows
sections.title_zh: 不能把合同库权限当作起草流程权益
sections.en: The homepage places templates, clause libraries, redlining, real-time collaboration and workflow automation in Premium. The pricing page describes a custom Premium scope. Some extracted comparison rows lose their graphical entitlement marks, so the profile uses the explicit product distinction rather than assuming that every visible feature belongs to Repository. Bring a third-party draft and one approval exception to the demonstration.
sections.zh: 主页把模板、条款库、修订、实时协作及流程自动化列入 Premium，定价页说明 Premium 采用定制范围。部分提取表格丢失图形权益标记，因此本文依据明确的产品区分，不把表格中所有可见功能算入 Repository。演示时可准备一份对方起草的合同及一个审批例外。

sections.title_en: Annual subscription and signature senders are separate counts
sections.title_zh: 区分年度订阅与签署发送人数
sections.en: The retrieved Repository offer starts at US$425 per month billed annually, with up to 50,000 documents, unlimited users and ten eSignature licences. This is an annual-billing equivalent, not a month-to-month quote. Premium is custom-priced. The FAQ lists additional sender licences in packs of five for US$1,200 per year, while recipients sign without an account. Older Essential/Enterprise labels still appear in that FAQ; confirm the order form rather than treating those as the current package structure.
sections.zh: 读取的 Repository 报价起于每月 425 美元、按年付款，最多 50,000 份文档、用户不限、含 10 个电子签署许可。这是年付折算，并非逐月付款价；Premium 需询价。FAQ 列出每年 1,200 美元可加购 5 个发送许可，收件人无需账户即可签署。FAQ 仍出现旧 Essential／Enterprise 名称，应以订单确认当前套餐。

sections.title_en: Include implementation and an exit check in the evaluation
sections.title_zh: 评估应包含实施和退出检查
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says template automation and onboarding are part of paid implementation. It also documents bulk document download and deletion within 30 days after cancellation and confirmation that the customer is off the system. Check whether an export includes the metadata and reminder configuration your team needs; document download alone does not establish complete configuration portability. The advertised 14-day trial is an evaluation period, not ongoing free use.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 说明模板自动化和上线配置属于付费实施，并说明可批量下载文档；取消订阅且确认已迁出后，厂商在 30 天内删除记录。应检查导出是否包括所需元数据和提醒配置，仅能下载文档不能证明全部配置可迁移。官网的 14 天试用属于评估期，并非持续免费使用。

sections.title_en: Match the product to post-signature control
sections.title_zh: 按签后管理需求匹配产品
sections.en: Repository is relevant to a contract administrator who needs to locate agreements and act on dates across a broad internal audience. A legal team needing negotiation and approval must examine Premium. Verify restricted-document access, reminder delivery and a corrected renewal date with representative records. Hosted access is documented; an open-source licence or self-hosted edition was not verified. No claimed implementation speed or customer saving was independently measured.
sections.zh: 需要让较多内部人员查找协议、按日期行动的合同管理员，可评估 Repository；需要谈判与审批的法务团队应核对 Premium。建议用代表性记录测试受限文件权限、提醒送达及续约日期修正。已核实托管访问，未核实开源许可或自托管版；本文未独立测量上线速度或客户节省。
